note: P repeats the nacreous/mother-of-pearl image in three of four poems (P1, P2, P4), but the subjects still differ: a dawn fjord, a mountain passage, an unseen cloud at dusk, and a rainbow veil. Q1 and Q2 are essentially one poem (sun behind the ridge, cloud edge turning mother-of-pearl, grey or blue taking over), so Q has only three real takes, with Q3 (lens cloud on a ridge) and Q4 (amber band, stars above) distinct.
